arguments.literal: The attribute ledger is the immediate semantic source of an entity cut. Every entry should be a fully qualified claim, potentially including a value or measured quantity; a rule or constraint; a classification; a topology or relation claim; provenance and authority information; and effective, observed and publication coordinates. The ledger may be supported by several evidence surfaces (documents for declared semantics or policy, code for derivation logic or invariants, data for observed state or emitted values). The profile does not assume one source per attribute; it assumes one lawful claim record per accepted attribute fact.
WORLD_MODEL §8 Attribute ledger law; P3, P4b, P6

An entity cut is admissible when its identity, boundary, authority, state, evidence, treatment, covariance and ambiguity are explicit, traceable, and discriminated from plausible alternatives at evidence altitude proportional to the claim. That is the whole constitutional test; it binds what is true of a published cut and does not prescribe how a builder establishes it.
WORLD_MODEL §9 Admissibility; P0, P3, P6

Discriminated from plausible alternatives means the cut states why this boundary rather than a nearby one the operating model would treat differently; the claim carries its own discrimination, and a stronger claim needs stronger discrimination. Techniques, none mandatory and none exhaustive: cross-context invariance; null-peer comparison (name a structurally similar entity the operating model treats differently and state what separates them); adjoint round-trip through an adjacent domain's treatment and back; transplant; coat stripping. Where a builder can intervene, interventional evidence discriminates more strongly than declarative evidence, and a cut should say which kind it rests on. A cut that states its boundary only as a set of source fields has made a weaker claim than one that states the reinterpretations under which identity survives, and is read as such.
WORLD_MODEL §9 Discrimination; P1, P3, P6

Entities are recovered, not invented. A builder project constructs an entity cut by trawling authoritative source surfaces for the boundaries the operating model already commits to, then qualifying them into published truth.
WORLD_MODEL §9; P3, P6

Explicit admits three lawful values on every surface: a stated value; a stated absence; a stated non-applicability with its reason. A surface that is none of these is not explicit. A cut whose entity has no adjacent-domain treatment says so; it does not manufacture one. A stated absence or stated non-applicability on an admissibility surface is a lawful surface value, not a non-satisfied result.
WORLD_MODEL §9 Admissibility, §14; P1, P5

A published entity cut makes the eight admissibility surfaces (identity, boundary, authority, state, evidence, treatment, covariance, ambiguity) visible and traceable, each as a stated value, stated absence or stated non-applicability, and records the basis on which identity was discriminated. Cuts are immutable: revising identity or boundary produces a new cut that supersedes the prior one. Concrete carriers, layouts, schemas and storage topology are consumer realisation; the profile requires that the published surfaces survive and does not select their storage form.
WORLD_MODEL §9 Publishing a cut; P0, P2, P3, P4b, P6
A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.

Builder projects may work a bounded source-object set repeatedly until the attribute ledger is judged sufficiently saturated for publication. Sufficient saturation means: materially important attributes have traceable support; remaining gaps are explicit ambiguities rather than silent misses; the resulting cut is stable enough to publish and supersede later if needed. Sparse first publication remains lawful; silent unsupported attribute creation does not.
WORLD_MODEL §11 Saturation law; P2, P5, P6

Sparse first publication remains lawful. A unique, historical, single-context, inaccessible or regulated entity is publishable when the admissibility test holds and its residual ambiguity is declared. Absence of a comparison population, of repeated contexts, or of permission to intervene is a bound on evidence altitude to be stated, not a bar to publication.
WORLD_MODEL §9 Admissibility; P2, P5

Each verdict answers its own question; nothing is coerced to satisfied. (1) admissible entity cut (§9): are the eight surfaces explicit, traceable and discriminated at evidence altitude proportional to the claim -> satisfied; a stated bound on evidence altitude with its residual ambiguity declared satisfies the test. (2) entity cut not admissible (§9): is a surface neither a stated value, a stated absence nor a stated non-applicability, or untraceable, or undiscriminated -> falsified, the surface being the counterexample; indeterminate only where the discrimination the cut itself claims cannot be decided at its stated altitude. (3) verified overlay direction (§10) -> satisfied. (4) inadmissible extraction, a principal-component or maximum-variance construction (§10) -> falsified whatever its verification. (5) failed verification (§10) -> falsified. (6) candidate direction, no verification run (§10) -> no evaluation result: unresolved under ACTIVATION §3's third case; the step that left it unrun stops incomplete, core indeterminate; publishing the direction is falsified for the publication claim. (7) not yet a lawful Markov object (§10): satisfied when the uniqueness and transfer tests both pass, falsified when either fails. (8) overlay with no declared representation space, or directions composed across spaces -> invalid_basis. (9) promotion gate (§4): satisfied when met; falsified for that gate run when not met; the construct's standing is unchanged. (10) sufficiently saturated (§11): do material attributes have traceable support with remaining gaps explicit -> satisfied, the explicit gaps carried as residuals; falsified where an attribute exists without support. (11) storage layout (§10): satisfied when the six surfaces are retained; falsified when any is lost. Candidate-class and established are standings of the construct, and candidate-class and formally closed are publication kinds; none is a result.
WORLD_MODEL §14; the one-algebra rule of ACTIVATION §3; P1, P5, P6
